jobs.title: Program Manager, Real Estate Transactions
jobs.description:
Overall Job Summary

The Program Manager, Real Estate Transactions, primarily serves as the operational leader for the company’s large-scale sale-leaseback transactions across a national real estate portfolio.  This role owns and continuously improves the operational execution framework for the company's sale-leaseback transaction program, managing transaction execution from pre-transaction planning through post-closing while ensuring alignment among Legal, Real Estate, Finance, external counsel, title companies, brokers, buyers, and other transaction stakeholders.  The Program Manager focuses on sale-leaseback transaction management, program governance, due diligence vendor oversight, and portfolio-level execution. In addition, this role manages closing readiness activities for fee development acquisitions and other strategic property transactions during the final stages of the transaction process.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (Min 5%)

- Direct execution of multiple concurrent sale-leaseback transactions and portfolio dispositions under aggressive timelines while ensuring achievement of transaction milestones and closing objectives.

- Develop and own standardized transaction management processes, reporting, governance tools, and execution methodologies for portfolio transactions.

- Manage due diligence vendors and activities, including the ordering, collection, organization, and delivery of title reports, ALTA surveys, environmental reports, zoning reports, property condition assessments, lease documentation, and other transaction-related materials.

- Develop, monitor, and present transaction performance metrics, portfolio status, key risks, and mitigation strategies to Legal and Real Estate leadership.

- Provide recommendations to support execution planning and business decision-making.

- Own the administration and governance of transaction data rooms and document repositories to ensure document integrity, accessibility, and closing readiness.

- Evaluate transaction risks, determine appropriate mitigation strategies, establish execution priorities, and independently resolve operational issues or elevate matters requiring legal or executive approval.

- Track satisfaction of closing conditions and coordinate delivery of transaction requirements necessary to achieve timely closings.

- Serve as the primary operational lead for transaction stakeholders, driving accountability, resolving cross-functional issues, and ensuring timely execution across internal and external partners.

- Lead closing readiness activities for fee development acquisitions and other strategic property transactions during the final stages of the transaction process by managing closing deliverables, monitoring satisfaction of closing conditions, coordinating stakeholder activities, and driving timely execution through closing.

- Establish and enforce adherence to transaction governance standards, documentation protocols, and execution procedures.

- Identify opportunities to improve transaction processes, standardize best practices, implement operational efficiencies, and recommend enhancements to transaction governance.

Required Qualifications

Experience: 5+ years of experience leading or managing complex commercial real estate transactions, including responsibility for transaction execution, stakeholder management, due diligence oversight, and closing management. Experience with sale-leasebacks, portfolio transactions, acquisitions, dispositions, or commercial development preferred. Demonstrated understanding of commercial real estate transaction execution, including closing processes and familiarity with title reports, ALTA surveys, environmental due diligence, zoning reports, and related transaction documentation.

Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university.  Any suitable combination of education and experience will be considered.

Professional Certifications: Paralegal Certificate a plus

Preferred knowledge, skills or abilities

- Proficiency using Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Teams.

- Advanced organizational skills with strong attention to detail

- Exceptional project and program management skills

- Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced transaction environment to keep multiple projects on track and completed within deadlines

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

- Demonstrated ability to build consensus and drive accountability across cross-functional teams without direct supervisory authority

- Experience creating and maintaining trackers, dashboards, process documentation, and transaction reporting

- Demonstrated ability to independently prioritize transaction activities and make operational decisions within established authority

- Excellent interpersonal skills including verbal and written communication, ability to preserve confidentiality, and collaboration

Working Conditions

- Normal office working conditions

Physical Requirements

- Sitting
- Standing (not walking)
- Walking
- Lifting up to 10 pounds

jobs.title: Sr. Analyst, FP&A
jobs.description:
Overall Job Summary

The finance team at Tractor Supply Company is a strategic partner of the executive and functional leadership teams. We influence decisions and strategy through data with the goal of benefiting our customers and shareholders. The Sr. Financial Analyst will develop models and reporting mechanisms that provide financial insights to executive and finance leadership as well as support budgeting, forecasting, and FP&A consolidations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (Min 5%)

- Provide analytical support to leadership across various functions, including Finance, Merchandising, and Marketing, by analyzing business performance, identifying key drivers, and developing actionable recommendations.

- Evaluate the financial performance and impact of promotions, marketing events, seasonal initiatives, and other merchandising programs. This may include analysis of sales lift, profitability, return on investment, and performance across stores, geographies, and merchandise categories.

- Prepare, maintain, and communicate recurring sales, gross margin, and financial forecasts; analyze actual results versus forecast and budget; and identify risks, opportunities, and key drivers of performance.

- Perform complex research and analysis of sales trends, customer behavior, category performance, and external business drivers, including economic conditions, weather, and market trends, to quantify potential impacts and inform forecasts and business decisions.

- Prepare and present period-end analyses and reporting on key business initiatives, such as Big Ticket, Private Label, Inventory Valuation, and Direct Imports.

- Conduct and present special financial and statistical studies as directed in coordination with other departments.

- Support the annual strategic planning and budgeting process by developing and validating key assumptions and coordinating with business partners to ensure financial plans accurately reflect business expectations

Required Qualifications

Experience: 4 -6 years of related business or retail experience.

Education:  Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in an appropriate business-related field of study.  Any suitable combination of education and experience will be considered.

Preferred knowledge, skills or abilities

- Strong communication, analytical and presentation skills

- Detail-oriented approach to work

- Proficient in interpreting financial data

- Strong technology skills to build budget/forecast models, as well as reporting

- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly an Excel Power user

- Proficient with software such as Business Objects, Cognos Planning, and SAP FICO

jobs.title: Store Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Overall Job Summary

The Store Operations Manager is responsible for leading operational execution in the store, with primary ownership of freight process execution and scheduling, F2F process execution, weekly recovery execution including Targeting Outs, backroom and dock standards, feed and food operational standards, security, and oversight of the Receiver role. This role is process-driven and promotes a safe, productive, compliant work environment while coaching Operations Team Members and supporting the Store Manager.

Do you love the life out here and want to share it with others? At Tractor Supply we strive to make the life out here a little bit better each day for both our neighbors and our teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (Min 5%)

It is essential that you be available, flexible, adaptable, and service-oriented, as you must be able to fulfill all of the following requirements:

- Maintain regular and predictable attendance.
Work assigned schedules based on business needs.

- Uphold and promote a safe and productive work environment by following and enforcing policies and procedures.

- Deliver Legendary Service and reinforce Leading with Legendary behaviors through Customer engagement, Team Member coaching, and accountability for execution.

- Use A+ Coaching routines to develop Team Members, improve selling behaviors, and reinforce consistent operating standards.

- Store-volume model: under $7M stores transition Assistant Store Manager responsibilities into the Store Operations Manager role.

- Store-volume model: $7M-$9M stores use Store Operations Manager ownership with an Ops Team routine; $8M-$9M stores remove the Sales Manager role from the model.

- Store-volume model: over $9M stores include a Sales Manager and a dedicated opening manager separate from the Store Operations Manager.

- Lead freight process execution and scheduling, including truck unload planning, freight movement, stocking execution, and follow-up to operational standards.

- Lead F2F process execution and ensure timely follow-up on assigned routines and process expectations.

- Lead weekly recovery process execution, including Targeting Outs, and ensure Store recovery standards are maintained.

- Oversee the Receiver role, including Receiver Weekly Checklist completion, coaching, development, follow-up, and accountability for receiving standards.

- Oversee inventory control and compliance processes completed by the Receiver, including inventory adjustments, discrepancies, negative on-hand review, PO processing, transfers, buybacks, RTV, and reconciliation routines.

- Maintain sidelot/FOD presentation, including signage, and ensure standards are executed consistently.

- Maintain backroom, dock, and assembly area standards, organization, and recovery.

- Maintain shelters, containers, feed centers, and related outside standards.

- Own damage feed/food markdown process execution and follow-up.

- Own the Styrofoam block process and pallet and wood crate process.

- Verify owners manuals are completed and maintained according to company standards.

- Own all store security processes and standards, including inside, outside, and high-dollar controls.

- Lead and coach assigned Operations Team Members; in applicable stores, manage direct reports and execute the Ops Team routine.

- In under $7M stores and $7M-$9M stores, open Monday-Friday except the designated freight/process day, based on the operating model.

- In over $9M stores, focus on operational execution without serving as the dedicated opening manager, based on the operating model.

- Support Store Manager with store operations, planning, prioritization, delegation, safety, compliance, and financial results.

- Operate forklift, baler, cash register/computer, and other equipment as needed; assist customers with loading purchases.

- Complete all documentation associated with the above job duties accurately and timely.

- Obtain license or certifications as needed by the business.

- May be required to perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

Experience: Previous retail leadership experience is required. Prior store operations experience and supervisory experience is strongly preferred. Farming, ranching, pet/equine, or welding knowledge is preferred. Must be 18 years of age or older and possess a valid driver’s license.

Education :  High school diploma or the equivalent is required.  Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or related field is preferred. Regardless of education level, you must be able to read, write, and count accurately.

Preferred knowledge, skills or abilities

- Ability to perform and execute principle responsibilities of Team Members.

- Strong interpersonal skills and ability to resolve issues ethically and with minimal conflict.

- Excels in a fast paced work environment

Working Conditions

- Indoor floors and outdoor lots generally are hard surfaces (concrete, asphalt, etc.) lighting and temperature are adequate.
- Work shifts vary from one store to another, but generally are no less than 4 hours and may exceed 10 hours
- Working environment is favorable, generally working inside with moderate noise.

- Strong interpersonal skills and ability to resolve issues ethically and with minimal conflict.

- Indoor floors and outdoor lots generally are hard surfaces (concrete, asphalt, etc.) lighting and temperature are adequate.
- Ability to work outdoors in adverse weather conditions.

- Promote a safe and productive work environment for all Team Members, customers, and vendors, as well as train Team Members on the appropriate application of policies and procedures.

Physical Requirements

- This position is non-sedentary.
- It is essential that you have the physical and mental stamina and ability to move throughout the distribution center and outdoor areas quickly and safely.
- It is essential to operate all equipment related to their job duties efficiently, safely, properly and accurately; and to provide the highest level of customer service.
- Team members must have the physical and mental ability to perform all of the following tasks (with or without reasonable accommodation):
- Ability to move and transfer merchandise, weighing up to 50 pounds, throughout the store.
- Ability to push and pull merchandise up to 2,000 pounds with the assistance of proper material handling equipment (e.g. pallet jack).
- Ability to occasionally lift or reach merchandise overhead.
- Ability to frequently stand, kneel, twist, crouch, squat, bend, stoop, and climb ladders.
- Ability to move throughout the store for an entire shift.
- Ability to safely access all areas of the store including selling floor, side lot, stock area, and register area.
- Ability to operate and use all equipment necessary to run a store (e.g. dolly, hand truck, forklift, baler, computer, cash register).
- Ability to constantly operate store equipment such as computer, cash register, and other store equipment.
- Ability to read, write, and count accurately to complete all documentation.
- Ability to utilize strong written and verbal communication skills to communicate effectively with team members and customers.
- Ability to process information / merchandise through the point-of-sale system.
- Ability to successfully complete training and certification to dispense propane, and to dispense propane.
- Ability to successfully complete all required training.
- Ability to travel as required in support of district needs.
- Ability to drive or operate a vehicle for business needs.
- Ability to successfully complete training and certification for various business needs.

jobs.title: Distribution Center HR Generalist (Nampa, ID)
jobs.description:
Overall Job Summary

This position is responsible for supporting the management of Human Resources (HR) activities, programs and policies that directly relate to the local distribution center (DC). These programs and policies include compensation, employee relations/labor relations, recruiting and employment, employee diversification/Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), performance management, training, and employee   communications.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (Min 5%)

- Manage the DC hourly staffing process to ensure staffing to approved levels, including recruiting, selection, onboarding and orientation team members.

- Ensure the accurate and timely review and maintenance of time keeping and attendance data, in support of the payroll process and local hourly attendance program.

- Assist and/or lead in the implementation of team member relations programs, policies and practices for the DC, to ensure consistent application of company or network-wide objectives.

- Provide counsel to local DC leadership on HR issues, while partnering with the HR Director for DC Operations and/or Employee Relations, in the absence of DC HR management.

- Manage Worker’s Compensation reporting, including recording of work-related injuries and maintaining the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) 301 Log and file. Follow-up on worker’s compensation injuries and rehabilitation.

- Assist with the timely implementation of approved performance measurement, training, and development programs to enhance the capabilities and performance of DC team members.

- Implement compensation programs to attract, retain and provide incentive for team members to maximize productivity and achieve desired goals.

- Analyze and interpret employee relations data to identify trends and training opportunities.

- Support team member communication planning, techniques and execution of local and corporate strategies and implementations at the DC level.

Required Qualifications

Experience : 3-5 years HR experience, preferably in a DC or manufacturing environment.

Education : Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or related field is preferred.  Any suitable combination of education and experience will be considered.

Preferred knowledge, skills or abilities

- Strong leadership, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.

- Ability to work independently.

- Detail-oriented approach to work.

- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

- Ability and willingness to flex working hours in order to support a multi-shift operation.

Working Conditions

- Normal office working conditions
- Required to work in a physical environment that is subject to temperature extremes, movement of mobile and fixed equipment, possible exposure to hazardous products, dust and other conditions associated with a warehouse operation

Physical Requirements

- Sitting
- Standing (not walking)
- Walking
- Reaching overhead
- Kneeling/Stooping/Bending
- Lifting up to 10 pounds
